questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed flask, 10g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the products must weigh the same as the reactants — 10g.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What gas is often seen bubbling off during a chemical reaction?
questions.why: Many reactions, like acids with metals or carbonates, produce a gas such as carbon dioxide or hydrogen, seen as bubbles — a key sign a reaction has happened.

questions.subject: PDHPE
